T: Subway hostage. Snacks on the platform.
D: Four men hijack a subway train and demand a ransom from the city.
P: Serve the snacks when Garber hears the sneeze.
S: breakfast in the transit dispatch room
Puff pastry squares with a sweetened cream cheese centre, folded corners, baked at 200C for 16 minutes and drizzled with thin icing.
Bakery jam doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes and rolled straight away in caster sugar.
Gesundheit sesame lavash with whipped feta
paper-thin, for Mr Green, the hijacker with the cold

Paper-thin lavash brushed with oil, salt and sesame, baked crisp and snapped into shards, with lemony whipped feta for dipping. Brush 4 sheets lavash with 3 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle with 2 tbsp sesame seeds and flaky salt. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp, cool and snap into shards. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and scatter with chilli flakes.
M: Long roll with sliced turkey, Swiss, shredded iceberg, tomato and mayo, wrapped tight in paper.
Whole chicken simmered 2 hours with carrot, celery, onion and dill, strained, meat back in, egg noodles.
W: Crescent-rolled cream cheese pastries filled with apricot jam, walnuts and cinnamon. Rub 225g butter and 225g cream cheese into 280g flour and chill 1 hour.
K: Mr Green's honey lemon whisky toddy
for Mr Green, whose sneeze gives the whole game away

Hot whisky with honey, lemon and fresh ginger, topped up with boiling water and stirred with a cinnamon stick. Thinly slice a 3cm piece of ginger. Into each of 4 heatproof glasses put 40ml whisky, 1 tbsp honey, 15ml lemon juice and two slices of ginger. Top each with 150ml just-boiled water and stir until the honey dissolves. Add a lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick and serve hot.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the day it is baked

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese with the sugar, egg yolk and lemon zest. Cut the pastry into 8 squares.
Spoon the filling into the middle of each square and fold in the corners.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Cool, then drizzle with the icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.
Warm the doughnuts on a tray at 160C.
Roll each straight away in the sugar so it sticks and serve on a plate in the middle of the table.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Split the rolls and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer with turkey, Swiss cheese, lettuce and tomato. Season.
Close, wrap tightly in paper and cut in half.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 3 days in an airtight tin

steps.text: Rub the butter and cream cheese into the flour to form a dough.
Chill the dough.
Roll into circles, spread with jam, walnuts and cinnamon sugar, cut into wedges and roll up from the wide end.
Bake at 180C until golden.

dishes.n: Mr Green's honey lemon whisky toddy

steps.text: Thinly slice the ginger and juice the lemons, keeping a few wheels.
Into each of 4 heatproof glasses put whisky, honey, lemon juice and ginger slices, top with boiling water and stir until the honey dissolves. Add a lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick.
Dice the carrots and celery and peel the onion.
Simmer the chicken in the water with the onion until cooked and the broth is rich. Lift out the chicken and shred the meat.
Cook the carrot, celery and noodles in the broth until tender, then return the chicken and season. Serve with saltines.
Steam the pastrami in a covered colander over simmering water until hot and soft.
Spread the rye with mustard, pile on the pastrami and close. Serve with a pickle each.
Butter the bread on the outside and fill with cheese.
Griddle until golden on both sides and the cheese is melted.
Serve with sliced tomato.
Pour a little syrup and milk into each of 4 tall glasses, top with a hard shot of seltzer and stir hard until it foams.
Blend the ice cream, milk, malt and fudge syrup until thick and spin into 4 tall glasses.

s.note: breakfast in the transit dispatch room
s.how: Beat 200g cream cheese with 50g caster sugar, 1 egg yolk and 1 tsp lemon zest. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 8 squares, spoon filling into the middle and fold in the corners. Bake at 200C for 16 minutes, cool 5 minutes and drizzle with 60g icing sugar mixed with 1 tbsp lemon juice.
Warm 8 jam doughnuts on a tray at 160C for 2 minutes. Roll each straight away in 80g caster sugar so it sticks, and serve on a plate in the middle of the table like the transit office tray.

m.how: Split 4 long rolls and spread each with mayonnaise, using 100g in total. Layer with 400g sliced turkey, 8 slices Swiss cheese, shredded iceberg lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes. Season, close, wrap tightly in paper and cut in half.

w.how: Rub 225g butter and 225g cream cheese into 280g flour and chill 1 hour. Roll into circles, spread with apricot jam, walnuts and cinnamon sugar, cut into wedges and roll up. Bake at 180C for 22 minutes.
